compaction.summary_head:
## Current goal

Deliver the `textcase` package: three public conversion functions (`to_snake_case`, `to_camel_case`, `to_kebab_case`) backed by one shared tokenizer, using only the Python standard library, with unittest coverage.

## Accep

deltas.content: Public API limited to three functions: `to_snake_case`, `to_camel_case`, `to_kebab_case`.
A single shared tokenizer feeds all three functions (no per-function splitting logic).
Token splitting is Unicode-aware, based on `\W`.
Uppercase / word-boundary detection is ASCII-only (deliberately narrower than the Unicode-aware splitting).
Test suite consolidated per sub-agent review: duplicate cases merged, 30 → 23 tests, coverage judged still adequate.
Process rule adopted: do not require diff evidence when the task is verification-only.
